锁定时间: 30分钟" style="text;html=1;align=left;valign=top;fontSize=9;fontFamily=monospace;fillColor=#f8f8f8;strokeColor=#cccccc;rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;spacing=4;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="1080" y="600" width="280" height="120" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="source-index" value="代码来源索引:

[blade-auth] BladeLockHandler: validateAccountLock, validateIpLock, accountLock, accountUnlock
[blade-auth] BladePasswordHandler: matches
[blade-auth] BladeTokenHandler: enhance(JWT)
[core-boot] SecureInterceptor: 权限拦截
[common/handler] BladePermissionHandler: permissionAll, hasPermission, hasMenu
[common/handler] BladeScopeModelHandler: SQL数据权限拦截
[common/cache] SysCache: Redis缓存管理
[blade-system] RoleController: grant, save role_menu, role_scope" style="text;html=1;align=left;valign=top;fontSize=9;fontFamily=monospace;fillColor=#f8f8f8;strokeColor=#cccccc;rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;spacing=4;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="10" y="760" width="400" height="130" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
